source.title: Synthetic guidance for governed AI automation
source.evidence_excerpt: Synthetic guidance recommends scoped permissions, human review for sensitive actions, continuous monitoring, complete audit records, validated integrations, gradual rollout, and environmental separation.

claim.text: AI automation should use explicit permissions, review points, observability, integration assurance, gradual autonomy, and containment controls.

event.summary: A synthetic advisory defined baseline controls for governed AI automation.

project_impact.impact_summary: The recorder should preserve approvals, permission changes, tool activity, integration identity, alerts, interruption, and rollback as first-class audit events.

candidate_action.title: Define the recorder audit-event vocabulary
candidate_action.rationale: A stable event vocabulary is needed before automated actions can be reviewed, interrupted, or replayed consistently.
